job.name: design5-aurora
job.meaning: Aurora: тёмно-синий фон со светящимися градиентами, стеклянные карточки, футуристичный AI-стиль
job.prompt: Website landing page design concept, full desktop page shown as one tall screenshot cropped to 16:9, for a Russian service that produces AI videos with a digital presenter (avatar) for corporate training, online courses, experts and products. Russian-language interface. Main headline exactly: «Видео без съёмок». Button labels exactly: «Смотреть примеры» and «Рассчитать стоимость». Small "LOGO" placeholder in the top-left. Other small text can be neat placeholder lines. No real brand names. Modern 2026 web design, professional UI, crisp, high quality. Style: AURORA GLASS. Dark navy background with soft glowing aurora gradients (violet, cyan, pink), frosted glass cards (glassmorphism) with subtle borders. Hero: digital presenter video inside a glowing glass frame, headline and a gradient button. Below: glass cards with industry examples, laptop and phone mockups with videos, pricing in glass cards. Elegant, high-tech.
